hints.title: Least to Most Significant Digit Transition
hints.text: Process digits from right to left, keeping track of the incoming carry and whether each number has started.

hints.title: Digit Validity Rules
hints.text: Once a number has started, its subsequent digits cannot be zero. Leading zeros are permitted before a number begins.

hints.title: Carry Propagation
hints.text: At each position, ensure (digit_a + digit_b + carry) % 10 equals the target digit of n, propagating integer division to next carry.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Digit DP with constant 10x10 transitions per digit.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all positive integers up to N costs O(N) which times out for large N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization state table of size log10(N) * 2 * 2 * 2.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Right-to-left digit DP tracking carry and leading zero flags.
